Free hero section templates

8 of the 156 templates in the library are free. Not a trial, not a watermarked preview — the same scroll-driven heroes as the rest of the library, with the same prompts behind them.

Each prompt is written to paste into Claude, Cursor, v0 or any agentic editor and produce a working, responsive hero rather than a rough approximation. Pick the one built for your kind of product, copy the prompt, and adapt the copy to your brand.

If you end up wanting the whole library, the paid plans unlock the core library and everything added to it later.
